paper_title: Laying the Foundation First Investigating the Generalization from   Atomic Skills to Complex Reasoning Tasks
caption: Error analysis on Vanilla model (left) and HCL model (right).
model_annotation: The image presents two pie charts illustrating the error analysis of the Vanilla model and the HCL model. The charts display four categories: Atomic Skill Fail, Correct, Reason Error, and Question Misunderstood. The Vanilla model chart on the left has four slices, with Atomic Skill Fail comprising approximately 68% in a dark blue color, Correct making up 8% in a light blue shade, Reason Error constituting 12% in a medium blue tone, and Question Misunderstood accounting for 12% in white. A legend at the top shows the color coding for each category. The slices are labeled with their respective percentages, and no slice is visually emphasized. The categories appear to be arranged in descending order of percentage. In contrast, the HCL model chart on the right also has four slices, with Correct making up 55% in a light blue shade, Reason Error constituting 21% in a medium blue tone, Question Misunderstood accounting for 14% in white, and Atomic Skill Fail comprising 10% in a dark blue color. Similar to the left chart, this chart includes percentage labels inside the slices and a legend, with no visually emphasized slices, and the categories are arranged in descending order of percentage.
